card.name: Words before treatment of reactions
card.fires_on: Small linking words like "the" or "to" right before "treatment" of a hypersensitivity reaction or anaphylaxis in warnings. Also fires partway through some split words in capitals.

modes.label: Link before treatment
modes.description: "the" or "to" just before treatment of anaphylaxis or hypersensitivity in administration warnings.
modes.example: Administer PEMGARDA only in settings in which healthcare providers have immediate access to medications<< to>> treat anaphylaxis and the ability

modes.label: Inside split capital words
modes.description: Partway through a long word written in capitals or split oddly, such as EMERGENCY or FOURTH.
